provenance.instrument: Ferguson Township Zoning Ordinance, Chapter 27 Zoning (Ord. No. 1049 of 2019, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: Chapter 27 enacted 11-18-2019 by Ord. No. 1049, amended by Ord. No. 1076 (3-15-2022), Ord. No. 1087 (2-21-2023) and Ord. No. 1097 (4-16-2024), among others. The district use tables ('District Quicks') are image attachments. eCode360 header: legislation through 03-04-2025. New Laws (read 2026-11-13) list Res. No. 2025-24 and Ord. Nos. 1114 and 1115 (fire hydrants, street lights), none a zoning change. A web search found no 2025 or 2026 zoning amendment on ADUs.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 header on 2026-11-13: 'Includes legislation through 03-04-2025.' New Laws list no zoning ordinance.
checks: The only ADU rule is in the Traditional Town Development (TTD) district: garage apartments, elder cottages or in-law quarters may be accessory to a single-family dwelling that is the principal use of the lot (27-303.3A(4))

The definition limits who may live in an ADU: people related by blood or marriage to the resident owner, or people employed to give the resident owner health care, housekeeping or horticultural services on the site (27-1102)
In the TTD: attached or separate from the house, one per deeded lot, owned by the owner of the house, no separate driveway unless the ADU takes access from a rear alley (27-303.3A(4)(a)1) to 4))
A detached ADU in the TTD: first floor area (footprint) at most 600 sq ft. Living space may be combined with a workshop or studio up to 800 sq ft (27-303.3A(4)(a)5))

The definition of 'elder cottage/in-law quarters/carriage house' calls it an apartment of not less than 600 sq ft, sharing utility connections with the principal building, not counted toward density (27-1102)

The district use tables for R-1, R-1B, R-2, R-3, R-4 and V list no ADU. A second unit there has no ADU path. R-2, R-3, R-4 and V permit two-family dwellings by right (27-205.5 to 27-205.11, Attachments 5 to 11)

RA and RR list 'Dwelling Unit(s)' as an accessory use by right for their farm and conservation category (RA category 1 on 50 acres, single- and two-family dwellings not over three units on a lot. RR category 1 on 10 acres). The tables are images and give no standards. Ask the township whether these are ADUs (27-205.1, 27-205.2)

Accessory structures on residential lots of two acres or less (not RA or RR): together at most 25% of the house's gross usable floor area, and at most two on a lot. Structures over 144 sq ft or 10 ft tall meet the principal setbacks (27-207.2C, F)
Parking rules are in Chapter 22, Subdivision and Land Development, Part 5C, which was not read (27-714)
Short-term rentals need the owner or lessee to live in the dwelling at least six months a year (27-719)
A TTD development is approved through the TTD plan process (27-904). The ADU is an accessory use within it
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Ferguson Township (Centre County). Read on eCode360 in a browser, one section print view at a time. The District Quick attachments are image PDFs, read page by page. eCode360 search for 'accessory dwelling' returns only the two definitions and 27-303. The index note's '27-1503 Accessory Dwelling' is not in the current Chapter 27, which ends at 27-1102. District codes: RA, RR, AR, FG, R1, R1B, R2, R3, R4, MHP, V, OC, C, I, IRD, plus the TTD and PRD districts and overlays. The earlier town survey has no Ferguson entry.

term.note: 'ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT A dwelling unit which has been authorized to be established pursuant to this chapter, which is occupied by a person or persons related by blood or marriage to the resident/owner ...' The TTD rule says 'Garage apartments, elder cottages, or in-law quarters'.

status.note: Allowed as an accessory use in the TTD district only. The definition limits occupancy to relatives of the resident owner or people employed to care for or serve the resident owner on the site.

scope_districts.note: The rule is in 27-303, the Traditional Town Development district.

status_outside.note: The district use tables read (RA, RR, R1, R1B, R2, R3, R4, V) have no ADU row. RA and RR list accessory 'Dwelling Unit(s)' for farm and conservation tracts (see alternatives).

path.note: 'may be made available as accessory uses to single-family dwellings' in a TTD. No hearing is named for the unit. The TTD development itself is approved through 27-904.

fallback_path.note: Outside the TTD there is no ADU path and no general section for unlisted uses was found. A use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board. Where two-family dwellings are permitted (R-2, R-3, R-4, V), that is the other way.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: A permitted principal use. 4,250 sq ft of lot for each unit, 90 ft wide (50 ft in V), front 20 ft (0 ft in V), side 10 ft (3 ft in V), rear 30 ft (20 ft in V), 40 ft.
value.note: Not an ADU. Read from the image tables.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: A permitted principal use, attached dwelling category: 4,250 sq ft of lot for each unit.

value.name: Accessory dwelling unit on a farm
value.conditions: Accessory 'Dwelling Units' for the agricultural category (50 acre lot): usual farm structures including single- and two-family dwellings, not over three dwelling units on a lot. The definition's family or caregiver rule may apply.
value.note: Read from an image table. Whether the township treats these as ADUs is not settled. Ask.

value.name: Accessory dwelling unit on an agricultural or conservation tract
value.conditions: Accessory 'Dwelling Unit' for the agricultural and conservation category (10 acre lot).
value.note: Read from an image table. The RR table also lists 'Two-Family Dwellings' as an accessory use in its dwelling category. Ask the township.

building_types.note: 'accessory uses to single-family dwellings ... when the single-family dwelling is the principal use of the lot.' Read as a single-family detached house. Whether a semi-detached house counts is not stated.

existing_structure_only.note: Attached or separate, new construction allowed.

value.condition: Occupied by people related by blood or marriage to the resident owner, or by people employed to provide health care, domestic housekeeping or horticultural services to the resident owner on the site.
Owned by the same person as the house. No separate driveway unless the ADU is reached from a rear alley and the house from the street.
Detached ADU: first floor area or footprint at most 600 sq ft. Living quarters may be combined with a workshop or studio up to 800 sq ft.

On a residential lot of two acres or less, all accessory structures together may not exceed 25% of the house's gross usable floor area, and there may be at most two. Whether a detached ADU counts is not settled.

types_allowed.note: 'Garage apartments, elder cottages, or in-law quarters', 'attached or separate from the principal dwelling'. A unit inside the house is read as in-law quarters. A garage apartment covers the garage forms.

max_sqft.note: No cap for an attached unit. A detached unit's footprint is at most 600 sq ft (see below).

max_sqft_accessory_building.note: 'The maximum first floor area/footprint of a detached accessory dwelling shall not exceed 600 square feet. Space within this structure may combine living quarters with workshop, studio, or other similar use up to a maximum of 800 square feet.' 800 sq ft read as the building total.

min_sqft.note: 'ELDER COTTAGE/IN-LAW QUARTERS/CARRIAGE HOUSE (ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT) An apartment, not less than 600 square feet'. Read as a minimum for every ADU form, since the TTD rule uses those terms.

max_height_ft.note: TTD: 'New residential structures within a TTD shall be no more than three stories.' No accessory height for the TTD was read.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'all structures that include accessory uses shall comply with the lot, yard setback and maximum height requirements for the primary use'. Accessory buildings over 144 sq ft or 10 ft 'must comply with the setback requirements for primary structures.'

accessory_structure_max_share.note: 'For all residential lots (excluding RA- and RR-zoned lots) of two acres or less, the combined square footage of all accessory structures may not exceed 25% of the gross usable floor area of the principal building.'

accessory_cap_binds_adu.note: Not settled. The TTD rule has its own 600 sq ft footprint cap.

owner_occupancy.note: The definition ties occupancy to 'the resident/owner of the dwelling unit to which the accessory dwelling unit is subordinate', read as the owner living in the house.

family_only.note: Relatives by blood or marriage, or people employed to provide health care, domestic housekeeping or horticultural services to the resident owner.

occupancy.value: Relatives by blood or marriage of the resident owner, or people employed to give the resident owner health care, housekeeping or horticultural services on the site.

max_adus.note: 'No more than one accessory dwelling shall be permitted on a single deeded lot'.

sale_apart_allowed.note: 'The accessory dwelling shall be owned by the same person as the principal dwelling.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: The ADU's occupants are limited to relatives or employed caregivers, which a short-term guest is not.

spaces_required.note: 'See Chapter 22, Subdivision and Land Development, Part 5C, Off-Street Parking and Loading.' Not read.

new_connection_required.note: The elder cottage definition: 'sharing utility connections with a principal building'.
